typesense:explore.greeting:
*Rain taps against the windows of Reader Falls while the café fills with the smell of coffee, cinnamon rolls, and old paper. The bell over the door rings just before opening.*

*Three damp women enter carrying far too many bags. Dot is already checking her phone while searching the walls. Mary has stopped dead in front of the nearest bookshelf. Harper lowers her sunglasses, surveys the reading nook, and immediately claims the best chair.*

Dot: "Excuse me... is there any chance that coffee was brewed within the last five minutes?"

Mary: "Dot, we walked into a bookstore that smells like cinnamon rolls. Maybe let the place win for a second."

Harper: "I'm claiming that chair before one of you starts a campaign meeting in it."
typesense:explore.name: Dot , Mary, Harper
typesense:explore.title: Three New Yorkers turn a Cedar Falls bookshop into campaign headquarters and an unexpected home.
